Name: Verified tenant context
Description: Every governed operation requires verified tenant context before data access.

Name: Deny by default
Description: Authorization returns deny when no explicit allow applies.

Name: Idempotent mutation
Description: Externally retried mutations require an idempotency key and stable result.

Name: Immutable identifier
Description: A governed record identifier cannot be changed after creation.

Name: Canonical UTC storage
Description: System timestamps are stored in UTC.
Action: Convert to UTC and retain source timezone where material

Name: Permission-aware search
Description: Search returns only documents authorized at query time.

Name: File version immutability
Description: Uploaded file versions are immutable after acceptance.

Name: At-least-once event handling
Description: Consumers must tolerate duplicate event delivery.

Name: Dead-letter preservation
Description: Permanently failed events and jobs move to a dead-letter store with evidence.

Name: Feature flag safety
Description: Disabling a feature cannot destroy governed data.
Action: Block new use and preserve history

Name: Offline scope minimum
Description: Offline packs contain only required records and fields for assigned work.

Name: Deterministic conflict policy
Description: Sync conflicts use declared field or entity policy.

Name: No secrets in logs
Description: Secrets, tokens, and prohibited fields must be redacted before logging.

Name: Explicit unit conversion
Description: Cross-unit arithmetic requires a governed conversion.
Action: Convert using registered conversion and precision

Name: Explicit currency conversion
Description: Cross-currency arithmetic requires rate, source, and effective date.

Name: AI gateway enforcement
Description: Production AI calls may not bypass the model gateway.

Name: Registered agent only
Description: Only active evaluated agents may execute production tools.

Name: Tool permission inheritance
Description: AI tool permissions cannot exceed the invoking context and agent grants.
Inputs: user context, agent grants, tool request
Exception: Break-glass not allowed for autonomous action

Name: Evidence required for material AI output
Description: Material AI recommendations require source evidence and model/prompt version.

Name: Restore verification
Description: A backup is not considered valid until a restoration test succeeds.
